description: List the editions of an Open Library work — its specific printings, each with publisher, date, language, ISBNs, page count and format. Takes the `open_library_work_key` returned by `search_books`, `get_book_by_title` or `get_book_by_id`. Returns at most `limit` editions (default 20, maximum 100) with `num_found`, the total; page through them with `offset`. Editions are in Open Library's order, not by date, and cannot be filtered. Pass an edition's `edition_key` to `get_book_by_id` as `{ idType: "olid" }` for its full record.

limit.description: Maximum number of editions to return (1-100, default 20).

offset.description: Number of editions to skip, for paging through the total reported as num_found (default 0).

work_key.description: The Open Library work key, e.g. OL45804W. The /works/OL45804W form returned by search_books, get_book_by_title and get_book_by_id is also accepted.

name: get_work_editions
title: List editions of a work
